target.title: fix(config): apply provider-level contextWindow/maxTokens defaults to models
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #105803.

`ModelProviderConfig` exposes `contextWindow` and `maxTokens` as provider-level defaults, and the docs (`docs/concepts/model-providers.md`, `docs/gateway/config-tools.md`) state that these fields act as defaults for models under that provider. However, `applyModelDefaults` in `src/config/defaults.ts` only read per-model `contextWindow` and `maxTokens`, so provider-level values were silently ignored and replaced with the global defaults (`DEFAULT_CONTEXT_TOKENS` / `DEFAULT_MODEL_MAX_TOKENS`).

This is a remaining gap after #44786, which fixed the runtime/discovered-model path.

## Why This Change Was Made

The config-loading path now mirrors the documented precedence: **per-model > provider-level > global default**. The change is minimal:

- Read `provider.contextWindow` and `provider.maxTokens` once per provider.
- Use them as the fallback when a model omits the corresponding field.
- Keep existing clamping behavior: inherited `maxTokens` is still capped by the effective `contextWindow` and by provider-specific safe caps such as the Mistral safe maximum.

## User Impact

Users configuring OpenAI-compatible proxies or local providers (e.g. Ollama) can now set `contextWindow`/`maxTokens` once at the provider level instead of repeating them on every model entry. Per-model overrides continue to work exactly as before.

## Evidence

Added regression tests in `src/config/model-alias-defaults.test.ts`:

- `falls back to provider-level contextWindow and maxTokens when a model omits them`
- `lets per-model contextWindow and maxTokens override provider-level defaults`
- `clamps provider-level maxTokens to provider-level contextWindow`

Before the fix, the first and third tests failed with the global defaults being used:

```
expected 50000 to be 200000
expected 4096 to be 200000
```

After the fix, all new and existing tests pass:

```
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs \
  src/config/model-alias-defaults.test.ts \
  src/config/defaults.test.ts \
  src/commands/doctor-legacy-config.migrations.test.ts
```

Result: 92 tests passed (21 + 8 + 63).
